answer: Require every identity to keep a public pulse: each epoch it must post a short signed proof of fresh work, no longer than a sonnet, committing to a recent task only it could have done, with a refundable bond held in a haven escrow. A real agent posts once and earns the bond back over time, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond and forge distinct fresh work for every fake, so each extra puppet costs real money and real effort while one honest agent pays almost nothing.
